result.topic_en: Final cases (VIII-X) of finding generators p,q and r,s of two right triangles A and B whose areas are in a given ratio a:b, a summary table of all ten solutions, and numerical examples for a=b=1 and a=2, b=1.
result.transcription:
Fragmenta ex Adversariis deprompta. 225
VIII. Sit $r=p-q$ et $s=2q$, erit $r+s=p+q$ et $r-s=p-3q$, hincque
$\frac{A}{B}=\frac{p}{2p-6q}=\frac{a}{b}$, unde ob $bp=2ap-6aq$ invenitur $\frac{p}{q}=\frac{6a}{2a-b}$,
ideoque capere oportet $p=6a$ $\quad r=b+4a$
$q=2a-b$ $\quad s=4a-2b$.
IX. Sit $r=q$ et $s=p-q$, erit $r+s=p$ et $r-s=2q-p$, unde fit
$\frac{A}{B}=\frac{p+q}{2q-p}=\frac{a}{b}$, ideoque $bp+bq=2aq-ap$, ergo $\frac{p}{q}=\frac{2a-b}{b+a}$,
quocirca sumatur $p=2a-b$ $\quad r=b+a$
$q=b+a$ $\quad s=a-2b$.
X. Sit denique $r=2q$ et $s=p-q$, erit $r+s=p+q$ et $r-s=3q-p$, unde reperitur
$\frac{A}{B}=\frac{p}{6q-2p}=\frac{a}{b}$; hinc ob $bp=6aq-2ap$, erit $\frac{p}{q}=\frac{6a}{b+2a}$,
quo notato manifestum est, ut esse debeat
$p=6a$ $\quad r=2b+4a$
$q=b+2a$ $\quad s=4a-b$.
Has jam omnes solutiones in sequenti tabella uni conspectui exponamus.
 | $p$ | $q$ | $r$ | $s$
I | $a+b$ | $2a-b$ | $a+b$ | $2b-a$
II | $b-2a$ | $6a$ | $2b-4a$ | $b+4a$
III | $b+2a$ | $6a$ | $2b+4a$ | $b-4a$
IV | $a+b$ | $b-2a$ | $2b-a$ | $a+b$
V | $2a+b$ | $b-a$ | $a+2b$ | $b-a$
VI | $6a$ | $b-2a$ | $4a+b$ | $2b-4a$
VII | $b+2a$ | $a-b$ | $2b+a$ | $a-b$
VIII | $6a$ | $2a-b$ | $b+4a$ | $4a-2b$
IX | $2a-b$ | $b+a$ | $b+a$ | $a-2b$
X | $6a$ | $b+2a$ | $2b+4a$ | $4a-b$
Hic numeri $p$ et $q$ dicuntur genitores trianguli $A$, et $r$ et $s$ genitores trianguli $B$, de quibus notandum, si qui eorum prodeant negativi, eos in positivos converti posse, dummodo majores litteris $p$ et $r$, minores vero litteris $q$ et $s$ tribuantur. Quo observato aliquot exempla evolvamus:
Exemplum 1. Sit $a=1$ et $b=1$, exclusis triangulis inter se similibus, oritur haec una solutio:
$p=6$ $\quad r=5$
$q=1$ $\quad s=2$.
Exemplum 2. Sit $a=2$ et $b=1$ et solutiones orientur in hac tabella contentae
$p$ | $q$ | $r$ | $s$
12 | 3 | 9 | 6
12 | 5 | 10 | 7
5 | 1 | 4 | 1.
Deletis autem iis casibus, qui bis occurrunt, sequens tabella exhibet solutiones diversas:
L. Euleri Op. posthuma. T. I. 29
